integrity: Source pointwise mean-square error and pairwise comparison credited to Cortinovis and Toni; the new claim is the global single-crossing classification and sharp geometric spectrum boundary. Exact arithmetic checks do not replace the general proof. Independent audit has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Exact known-spectrum deflation, exact real Gaussian quadratic forms and nominal constant per-probe matvec charge.
Does not imply a free observable stopping rule or carry over to randomized Nystrom, inexact Lanczos, or computational wall-clock optimization.
An equivalent global single-crossing criterion elsewhere in classical stochastic trace estimation remains possible.
title: Single-crossing optimality of Gaussian probe allocation after ideal spectral deflation
